name: Jenkinstown Park
questions: Bedroom 1 wasn't accessed for the brochure: what size is it, and can you send a floor plan and the workshop's dimensions?
When will the BER certificate be ready, and is the Daft 'D' a placeholder? Is the LPG tank owned or rented, and what did heating cost last year?
Can you share a recent well-water test and the septic tank's age and any inspection or certification? Has the site or access lane ever flooded, and has the house been tested for radon?
Can you send a site map of the 1.3 acres showing the boundaries, fencing and gate? Does the access cross the 18.5-acre lot, and would any rights of way or shared access survive a separate sale?
BuyerIQ shows four planning applications within 1 km: do you know what they are, and what are the adjoining 18.5 acres used for now?

ai.why: Two ground-floor bedrooms, a downstairs shower room, 1.3 acres and Kilkenny's ED, schools and station 10 minutes away, at €395k. But about 127 m² with a small kitchen, LPG heating and the BER still to come.

electricity.detail: Likely connected; not stated, but the house is lived in, with alarm and CCTV.

water.detail: Private well, stated in the listing; ask for a water test.

sewer.detail: Septic tank, stated in the listing; ask its age and condition.

internet.detail: Full fibre likely: not in the listing, but BuyerIQ shows '387 Mb full fibre' at this address. Confirm the provider by Eircode.

groundFloorBedroom.detail: Bedrooms 1 and 2 are on the ground floor (Bedroom 2 is 3.5 × 3.25 m with a bay window; Bedroom 1 wasn't measured), beside a guest shower room.

bedsNote: Two bedrooms on the ground floor, two upstairs
heating: LPG (Calor) gas central heating, new Worcester boiler; solid-fuel stoves in the kitchen and sitting room
tagline: A restored four-bed house with two bedrooms downstairs on 1.3 acres in the old Jenkinstown demesne, about 10 minutes north of Kilkenny city.

pros.detail: About €3,110/m²; stamp duty about €3,950, leaving room for an extension.

pros.text: Two ground-floor bedrooms and a shower room
pros.detail: Bedrooms 1 and 2 and a guest shower room are downstairs, so Gabor's parents need not climb stairs.
About 0.53 ha, above the 1-acre target for the vizslas.

pros.text: Kilkenny's ED and city about 10 minutes
pros.detail: The listing says 8–10 minutes to Kilkenny; St Luke's (24-hour, all-ages ED) is about 7 km straight-line.
Clinstown NS (mixed, 127 pupils, up 37% since 2019) is about 2.3 km straight-line; Kilkenny College (mixed) and St Kieran's (boys, 100% to third level in 2023) are about 7–9 km.
Listed as 'beautifully restored and extensively renovated', with a new Worcester boiler, double glazing, alarm and CCTV.
Jenkinstown Wood (Coillte, 1–3 km loop walks) is about 1.2 km straight-line from the house: daily dog walks.

pros.text: Workshop, plus an option on 18.5 acres
pros.detail: A large workshop to the rear; the adjoining 18.5 acres are for sale separately at €460k (€855k together, over budget).

cons.text: About 127 m², under the 140 m² floor
cons.detail: 1,362 sq ft ≈ 127 m², 13 m² short; a ~30 m² extension would be a rough €70–100k.
Kitchen/dining 3.66 × 3.86 m and sitting room 3.5 × 4.2 m: tight for a family of four plus visiting parents.

cons.text: BER still to come; LPG heating
cons.detail: The BER is 'to follow' (Daft and BuyerIQ show a D). LPG is costly to run; a heat pump and insulation would be a rough €30–50k before grants.

cons.text: Only about 7 Dublin trains a weekday
cons.detail: Kilkenny MacDonagh is about 10 km by road, then about 1h30–1h45 to Heuston.
The guest shower room is 1.9 × 1.25 m, and the agent had no access to Bedroom 1 for the brochure.
Ask for a water test and the tank's age and condition, especially for rental use.
No aerial or satellite check yet (no browser); BuyerIQ notes four planning applications within 1 km and flags one critical and five high-priority items behind its paywall.

cons.text: No village shop on the doorstep
cons.detail: Groceries are in Kilkenny city or Ballyragget, roughly 8–10 km either way.
